help.title: Help Menu
help.description: Provides detailed help instructions for the Gemini CLI.
help.response:
🧩 Usage:
- npm run gemini:cli -- <command>
- npm run gemini:greet
- npm run gemini:build
- npm run gemini:list

💡 Use Ctrl+C to exit interactive chat mode.
